reason: The task contract: Scheme B three-outcome model, two-tier deadline (2s start-gate / 10s completion), new WriteTimeout variant, and the requirement to preserve #2 desync protection.

Timeout-variant rules: transport-neutral structured signal, never string-match timeout text, never feature-gate the timeout concept; new RustADBError variant requires an exhaustive arm in adb_cli_error.rs.
Clippy pedantic, MSRV 1.88.0, edition 2024, inline #[cfg(test)] test style; CI runs default features only so the usb write path must be verified locally with --features usb.
Frame = 24-byte header + payload; integrity is magic-only. The write path must keep emitting whole frames; do not alter framing or add crc on the write side.
